step1_analysis.description: A differential amplifier acting as a delay cell for a Delay-Locked Loop (DLL). It uses an NMOS differential pair with a diode-connected PMOS load to provide a controllable delay.

paper_reference.title: A Wide-Range Delay-Locked Loop With a Fixed Latency of One Clock Cycle

power.description: DC power consumption of the delay cell

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on SKY130 NMOS parameters and VBN=0.54V.

dc_gain.description: Low-frequency voltage gain from differential input to single-ended output

sky130_expected.reasoning: Ratio of input NMOS gm to load PMOS gm.
Bandwidth is determined by the diode-connected load resistance and parasitic capacitance.
Estimated from RC time constant of the output node.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC gain, bandwidth, and transient propagation delay of the delay cell.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Wide-Range Delay-Locked Loop Delay Cell Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u

XM1 N4 VBN GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 VO_MINUS VI_PLUS N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 VDD VDD N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N1 VBN GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 VDD VDD VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 VO_PLUS VI_MINUS N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 VO_PLUS VO_PLUS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 VO_MINUS VDD VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 VO_PLUS VDD VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVBN VBN 0 0.54

VIP VI_PLUS 0 DC 0.9 AC 0.5 PULSE(0.4 1.4 1n 100p 100p 2n 4n)
VIM VI_MINUS 0 DC 0.9 AC -0.5 PULSE(1.4 0.4 1n 100p 100p 2n 4n)

.control
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power
  
  ac dec 20 1Meg 10G
  let gain_db = vdb(vo_plus)
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1Meg
  let gain_db_3db = dc_gain - 3
  meas ac bw when gain_db=gain_db_3db fall=1
  
  tran 10p 10n
  meas tran v_max max v(vo_plus)
  meas tran v_min min v(vo_plus)
  meas tran delay_rise trig v(vi_minus) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(vo_plus) val=1.25 rise=1
  meas tran delay_fall trig v(vi_minus) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(vo_plus) val=1.25 fall=1
  
  quit
.endc
.end
